# Feature catalog

The feature catalog lists Regia Engine's features by area, with the page, crate and spec for each one. Edit `docs/manual/features.ron` and run `cargo xtask manual`; this page is generated. Status words in the source today are `shipped`, `partial` and `planned`; any other word is printed as written. Rows stay in the source order so an inventory can append them.
